lyrics:
[Intro: piano slide, busy bass line, guitar chops, strings]

[Verse 1: bright high lead, the group answers softly]
Had it good and I didn't know
Walked right by like a picture show
Now you're laughing with the kid from down the street
And I'm standing here with two left feet

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, group rises]
Oh, I was looking the other way
When the best thing came to stay

[Chorus: lead and group trading, full band]
Oh, give me that yesterday
(Back in my hands)
I'd do it another way
(I'd understand)
All I want, all I need
Is one more go at being me
With you

[Verse 2: bright high lead, bass busier]
Every corner, I see your face
Every song, it's the same old place
I was busy being cool and being smart
Didn't know I had a breakable heart

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, group rises]
Oh, I was looking the other way
When the best thing came to stay

[Chorus: lead and group trading, full band]
Oh, give me that yesterday
(Back in my hands)
I'd do it another way
(I'd understand)
All I want, all I need
Is one more go at being me
With you

[Breakdown: bass and handclaps, lead ad-libbing, group chanting]
Yesterday (bring it back)
Yesterday (bring it back)
I'd know it this time

[Final Chorus: everything, lead soaring over the group]
Oh, give me that yesterday
(Back in my hands)
I'd do it another way
(I'd understand)

[Outro: bass line, group chant, fade]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 98 BPM, 4/4, A-flat major. A bouncing, tightly arranged soul-pop groove. Bursting with energy.

VOICE: A lead voice that sounds like a very gifted child: high, bright, clear and full of feeling, with gospel inflections well beyond his years. A group of older brothers answers each line in harmony and chants in the breakdown.

INSTRUMENTS: A piano that opens with a downward slide. A restless, melodic electric bass, the engine of the track. Clean guitar playing bright chops and a little counter-melody. A string section. A crisp drum kit with a busy hi-hat. Handclaps and tambourine. Congas.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the piano slide and the bass line. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:32 Pre-chorus. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:04 Verse 2. 1:24 Pre-chorus. 1:34 Chorus 2. 1:56 Breakdown, bass and handclaps. 2:14 Final chorus. 2:30 Outro, bass and chanting, fading by 2:48.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1960s Motown made in Los Angeles: bright, tight and packed with detail, bass and lead voice loudest.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The piano slide into the bass line in the first three seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: 'I was busy being cool and being smart' is a line for anyone looking back. The child's voice sings what the adult listener thinks, which is how the original has always worked on grown-ups.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Regret, pleading, hope.
